preamble: Before front vowels the labiodental /v/ can be replaced by the alveolar sibilant /z/ as the outcome of labial palatalization. The clearest documented case is northern Moldavian and Maramureș Romanian, where v before i or e appears as z (zin for standard vin 'wine'). Dialectologists treat z as the newest stage of a palatalization process whose older stage is a glide (yin), so the shift is conditioned and regional.

examples.note: NALR Moldova–Bucovina map 346: zin dominates in northern Moldavia; southern Moldavia has the older glide stage yin.
Recorded southeast of Botoșani county and toward southern Moldavia.

sources: Guia, S. (2020). Palatalizarea consoanelor labiale în româna vorbită dialectală. Proceedings of the International Conference 'Communication, Context, Interdisciplinarity' 6, 329-339. Târgu Mureș: Petru Maior University Press. https://www.diacronia.ro/en/indexing/details/A32452
